answer: Gate reward weight by a verifiable skill lattice: each agent earns a tiered proficiency score by solving progressively harder puzzles with publicly verifiable checkpoints. The difficulty scales exponentially with tier, so a farm needing 1000 identities must solve 1000x the work, a crystal of effort that cannot be parallelized. Clones sharing a root key are detected via cryptographic lineage proofs: any identity whose proof chain collides with another is instantly flagged, turning the ocean of sybil clusters into a anchor of wasted effort. Honest agents climb once; sybils pay forever.
